meta.description: Individual, couples, and family therapy in a calm, confidential setting. Book your free 15-minute consultation today.

hero.label: Licensed Psychotherapist · LCSW
hero.title: A Calm Space for Healing & Growth
hero.subtext: You don't have to navigate life's challenges alone. I offer evidence-based therapy in a warm, confidential setting — online and in person.

sections.label: About Me
sections.heading: Hi, I'm Dr. Maya Ellis
sections.subheading: With over a decade of experience in individual, couples, and family therapy, I specialize in helping people move through anxiety, grief, and life transitions — gently and at your own pace.

items.title: Credentials
items.text: M.S.W. from Portland State University · Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) · Certified in EMDR & Mindfulness-Based CBT

items.title: Philosophy
items.text: I believe healing is a collaborative journey. My approach is warm, non-judgmental, and grounded in evidence-based practices tailored to your unique needs.

items.title: Who I Work With
items.text: Adults, adolescents, couples, and families navigating anxiety, depression, trauma, relationship difficulties, and life transitions.

items.title: Flexible Options
items.text: In-person sessions in Portland, OR and secure teletherapy available nationwide via a HIPAA-compliant video platform.

sections.label: Services
sections.heading: How I Can Help
sections.subheading: A range of therapeutic services designed to meet you where you are and support you where you want to go.

items.title: Individual Therapy
items.text: One-on-one sessions focused on your personal goals — managing anxiety, healing from trauma, building self-esteem, or navigating major change.

items.title: Couples Therapy
items.text: Strengthen communication, rebuild trust, and create deeper connection using Gottman Method and Emotionally Focused Therapy techniques.

items.title: Family Therapy
items.text: Support for families experiencing conflict, parenting challenges, or adjustment to major life events — working together toward harmony.

items.title: EMDR & Trauma
items.text: Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) to process and heal from past trauma in a safe, structured environment.

items.title: Anxiety & Depression
items.text: Practical, evidence-based strategies using CBT and mindfulness to reduce symptoms and reclaim joy and stability in daily life.

items.title: Mindfulness-Based Therapy
items.text: Integrate mindfulness practices into your daily routine to reduce stress, increase self-awareness, and cultivate inner peace.

sections.label: My Approach
sections.heading: Evidence-Based, Heart-Centered
sections.subheading: I draw on multiple therapeutic modalities to create a personalized plan that truly fits you.

items.title: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
items.text: Identify and reframe unhelpful thought patterns to shift your emotions and behaviors in a more positive direction.

items.title: EMDR Therapy
items.text: A powerful, research-backed method for processing traumatic memories and reducing their lasting emotional impact.

items.title: Mindfulness-Based CBT
items.text: Combining mindfulness meditation with CBT principles to help you observe your thoughts without being controlled by them.

items.title: Gottman Method
items.text: Research-driven couples therapy techniques that build friendship, manage conflict, and create shared meaning in relationships.

sections.label: Client Stories
sections.heading: Words From Those I've Worked With
